verdict.rationale: ADK is a framework that can be self-hosted. It runs offline or disconnected from Google Cloud, can be packaged into containers for any environment, and supports locally running models, so the builder keeps custody of agent data and controls its lifecycle. Artifacts are described as persistent outputs that agents 'create and manage', which hints at storage lifecycle control but says nothing about deletion. Missing for 10: explicit session/state or artifact deletion APIs, configurable retention policies or TTLs, documentation of data retention on managed deployments (Agent Runtime, Cloud Run), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
